input.code:
contract_id = input['contract_id'].to_s contract_id = 'UNKNOWN' if contract_id.empty? t = input['t'].to_s stored_token = input['cro_token'].to_s status = input['status'].to_s.upcase customer = input['customer_name'].to_s drive_file_id = input['drive_file_id'].to_s esc = lambda { |s| s.to_s.gsub('&','&').gsub('<','<').gsub('>','>') } token_ok = !t.empty? && !stored_token.empty? && t == stored_token decided = %w[APPROVED REJECTED].include?(status) proceed = token_ok && !decided brand_head = %(
brightdata
BrightMind · Deal Sign-off
) brand_foot = %(
🤖 BrightMind · Bright Data · #{esc.call(contract_id)}
) if !token_ok page = %(
#{brand_head}
⚠️

Invalid Link

This link isn't valid for this contract. Please contact Deal Desk.

#{brand_foot}
) elsif decided page = %(
#{brand_head}
ℹ️

Already Processed

This deal was already #{esc.call(status)}. No further action is needed.

#{brand_foot}
) else cust_line = customer.strip.empty? ? '' : " · #{esc.call(customer)}" locked_link = drive_file_id.strip.empty? ? '' : "https://drive.google.com/file/d/#{drive_file_id}/view" btn = locked_link.empty? ? '' : %(
View Approved Contract
) page = %(
#{brand_head}
✅

Deal Approved

Contract #{esc.call(contract_id)}#{cust_line}

🔒 Contract file locked
✅ Deal Desk notified
✅ Registry updated → APPROVED
#{btn}

You can close this tab.

#{brand_foot}
) end { 'html_page' => page, 'proceed' => proceed }

input.code:
require 'json' contract_id = input['contract_id'].to_s customer = input['customer_name'].to_s quote_number = input['quote_number'].to_s quote_url = input['quote_url'].to_s dealroom = input['dealroom_link'].to_s drive_file_id = input['drive_file_id'].to_s cro_name = input['cro_name'].to_s submitted_by = input['submitted_by'].to_s # SFDC links opportunity_id = input['opportunity_id'].to_s account_id = input['account_id'].to_s sfdc_base_url = input['sfdc_base_url'].to_s sfdc_base = sfdc_base_url.strip.sub(/\/+\z/, '') opp_link_url = (opportunity_id.strip.empty? || sfdc_base.empty?) ? '' : "#{sfdc_base}/#{opportunity_id}" account_link_url = (account_id.strip.empty? || sfdc_base.empty?) ? '' : "#{sfdc_base}/#{account_id}" cro = cro_name.strip.empty? ? 'CRO' : cro_name cust = customer.strip.empty? ? '—' : customer qn = quote_number.strip.empty? ? '—' : quote_number customer_display = account_link_url.empty? ? cust : "<#{account_link_url}|#{cust}>" locked_link = drive_file_id.strip.empty? ? '' : "https://drive.google.com/file/d/#{drive_file_id}/view" # ============ DEAL DESK MESSAGE ============ dd_header = " :white_check_mark: *Deal Approved by CRO — Ready to Process*" dd_meta = [ { 'title' => '*Customer:*', 'value' => customer_display }, { 'title' => '*Quote:*', 'value' => qn }, { 'title' => '*Contract:*', 'value' => contract_id }, { 'title' => '*Approved by:*', 'value' => cro }, { 'title' => '*Salesperson:*', 'value' => (submitted_by.strip.empty? ? '—' : submitted_by) }, { 'title' => '*Status:*', 'value' => ':lock: APPROVED & LOCKED' } ] dd_body = ":white_check_mark: The contract is *approved and locked*, ready for signature." dd_links = [] dd_links << ":page_facing_up: <#{locked_link}|Approved contract>" unless locked_link.strip.empty? dd_links << ":link: <#{quote_url}|Quote in DealHub>" unless quote_url.strip.empty? dd_links << ":bar_chart: <#{opp_link_url}|Opportunity in Salesforce>" unless opp_link_url.empty? dd_links << ":briefcase: <#{dealroom}|Open DealRoom>" unless dealroom.strip.empty? dd_links_text = dd_links.empty? ? ' ' : dd_links.join(' · ') dd_steps = ":arrow_right: *Next steps for Deal Desk:*\n" dd_steps += "• Upload the signed file to the DealRoom" dd_footer = ":robot_face: BrightMind · CRO sign-off complete · #{contract_id}" # ============ GUNJA CONFIRMATION REPLY (Slack) ============ gunja_reply = ":white_check_mark: *Approved — #{contract_id}*\n\n" gunja_reply += ":lock: Contract file locked\n" gunja_reply += ":white_check_mark: Deal Desk notified\n" gunja_reply += "Registry updated → APPROVED" # ============ GUNJA SUCCESS PAGE (HTML — browser) ============ esc = lambda { |s| s.to_s.gsub('&','&').gsub('<','<').gsub('>','>') } contract_btn = locked_link.strip.empty? ? '' : %( View Approved Contract) gunja_html = <<~HTML
✅

Deal Approved

Contract #{esc.call(contract_id)}#{cust == '—' ? '' : " · #{esc.call(cust)}"}

🔒 Contract file locked
✅ Deal Desk notified
✅ Registry updated → APPROVED
#{contract_btn}

🤖 BrightMind · CRO sign-off · #{esc.call(contract_id)}

You can close this tab.

HTML { 'dd_header' => dd_header, 'dd_meta' => dd_meta, 'dd_body' => dd_body, 'dd_links' => dd_links_text, 'dd_steps' => dd_steps, 'dd_footer' => dd_footer, 'gunja_reply' => gunja_reply, 'gunja_html' => gunja_html, 'contract_id' => contract_id, 'locked_link' => locked_link }
